name: ePSXe
description:
ePSXe is a classic PlayStation 1 (PSX/PS1) video game console emulator. Utilizing a modular plugin architecture, it provides compatibility with a vast library of Sony PlayStation titles.

Features:
- High compatibility rate with commercial PlayStation 1 game discs and image files
- Modular plugin system for video, audio, and CD-ROM configuration
- Hardware-accelerated 3D graphics enhancements and resolution upscaling
- Support for digital and analog gamepads with force feedback vibration
- Save state support and memory card management
